description: This file contains functions and constants for processing, sanitizing, and rendering Markdown content into safe HTML, including caching, hook installation for DOMPurify, and custom rendering logic.

methods.name: getCachedMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves cached sanitized HTML for a given markdown string, updating its position in the cache.

methods.name: setCachedMarkdown
methods.description: Stores a sanitized HTML string in the cache associated with a markdown input.

methods.name: installHooks
methods.description: Sets up DOMPurify hooks to sanitize anchor tags and prevent dangerous URL schemes, adding rel and target attributes, and special classes for tail links.

methods.name: toSanitizedMarkdownHtml
methods.description: Converts markdown text into sanitized HTML, with caching, truncation, and custom rendering, including handling large inputs and fallback for parse errors.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: renderEscapedPlainTextHtml
methods.description: Converts plain text into HTML-safe escaped text wrapped in a div.
